notes.title: Update - Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Update version 1.02 is now available!

With this update, we now have Chinese language support (Traditional/Simplified) in the game.
The game can now be played fully in Chinese!

Also included within this update are a few quality of life improvements.
You can now set up Rooms for online battles, which allow players to set up private or public rooms for coordinated matches.

For players who have been having issues running to game smoothly, the long-requested low graphics option is now available!

Players can now move during the Ready phase of battle in order to take up strategic positions for the start of battle.
Additionally, a few additional balancing adjustments were made to make battling fairer.

See the detailed patch notes below:

Language support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/f67f9b7d3e578b226def64fa77b3575720519d39.png

Added Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) support.


QoL Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/9713f0f039a2ae1bdfdc2b11d6531defe05ec2f9.png

The Room feature is now available in online play.
Players can now browse an existing list of rooms to join, as well as set up their own rooms for matching.
Hosts can set public/private settings to their rooms, as well as add passwords.

New graphics settings added to menu

Default: Default graphics setting.
Low: Shadows and some effects are disabled, making it lighter than the Normal option.
Very Low: Rendering is set to the lowest level, with outlines disabled.
All Shots are set to a simple style, and some aspects of visual customization on Shots will not display. This is the lowest graphic option.

Under the Very Low settings, we've tested a lower-end computer (Intel HD Graphics 620, screen resolution 1280x720) and found that it runs at about 50fps or more.
(*We cannot guarantee results for hardware without graphic cards; depending on your hardware's specifications, the game may not run smoothly.)
Players can now move during the Ready phase.


Balance adjustments

Dash, Jump Dash, and Jump Cancel can no longer be interrupted mid-way due to damage.
Tweaked damage calculation formula.
Tweaked result score calculation.
Stun time during Guard has been modified.
Vertical (Y-axis) homing of bullets has been adjusted.
The strength of dynamic curvature for bullet trajectories during homing has been adjusted.

notes.title: Version 1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386796/27a79ed1e39b966176fca918dfa552af4ab213f0.gif
Hello Crafters,
The version 1.01 update is now available!
This update is focused on improving character's defense performance, which is helpful in recovering from blockstun when you take damage by intense Shots (like Machine-gun).

Changelog
Combat

 Increased total amount of Guard Points.
 Adjusted blockstun time to be shorter.
 Perfect Guards are now unaffected by blockstuns.
 Increased input angle for Perfect Guards.
 Added cap to blockstun time when receiving multiple attacks.

Others

 Tweaked the score calculation formula.


Feel free to let us know your opinions and feedback over here.

English
日本語(Japanese)

Thank you for all your support!
